content.title: About
content.content: A pepper‑flavored diet soft drink is a low‑calorie carbonated beverage that uses artificial sweeteners instead of sugar. It combines a subtle pepper heat with refreshing fizz, making it popular among fans of unconventional flavors and those watching their sugar intake.

content.title: Interesting Facts
items: The pepper aroma is obtained from red pepper extract, providing a mild spiciness without a burning sensation.
The diet version typically uses sucralose or stevia, keeping calories to 0–5 kcal per 100 ml.
Carbonated water enhances the perception of flavor and adds a crisp mouthfeel.
The drink is often marketed as “energy‑boosting” because capsaicin can slightly raise metabolism.
In some markets the product is sold in limited batches due to its niche taste profile.

items.title: Metabolism support
items.content: Capsaicin from pepper extract may modestly increase metabolic rate and aid calorie burning.

items.title: Low calorie
items.content: Being sugar‑free allows enjoyment without a significant increase in daily caloric intake.

items.title: Hydration
items.content: Carbonated water helps maintain fluid balance, especially in warm weather.

items.title: No sugar
items.content: Suitable for people with diabetes or those following low‑carb diets.

items.title: Antioxidant effect
items.content: Pepper extract contains small amounts of vitamin C and polyphenols with antioxidant properties.

items.title: Capsaicin sensitivity
items.content: Even mild spiciness can cause stomach discomfort or heartburn in sensitive individuals.

items.title: Artificial sweeteners
items.content: Excessive intake of sucralose or stevia may lead to gastrointestinal upset in some people.

items.title: Carbonation
items.content: Carbonated drinks can increase bloating and gas.

items.title: Pepper allergy
items.content: Rarely, an allergic reaction to pepper extract components may occur.

content.title: How to Eat
content.content: Serve the drink chilled, straight from the bottle to preserve carbonation. It works as a refreshing snack between meals, a sugar‑free alternative to regular sodas, or as a base for non‑alcoholic cocktails.

content.title: Storage
content.content: Keep the bottle in a cool, dry place away from direct sunlight. Once opened, consume within 3–5 days, sealing the cap tightly to maintain fizz and flavor.
